properties.disease overview:
A degenerative joint disease characterized by progressive articular cartilage loss with secondary changes in subchondral bone and periarticular tissues, leading to pain and functional limitation.

核心要点：软骨退变/磨损 → 关节间隙变窄；软骨下骨硬化、骨赘形成、软骨下囊肿等改变。
properties.mechanism: Cartilage fibrillation/fragmentation → cartilage erosion → joint space narrowing; altered load transfer leads to subchondral sclerosis and osteophyte formation; may also develop subchondral cysts. Risk is increased by aging, obesity, malalignment, prior injury, genetics.
